title: Mixed Event — One Small Trip Before a Big Journey — Episode5 Today, I'm A High Schooler

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey
meta.Episode: Episode5 — Today, I'm A High Schooler
meta.Event Outline: The Miya Girls first years are headed to Yokohama! Haruka realizes this field trip might be her last memory with her general education class before returning to the credit-based course. Saki asks to be in her group for the trip.

rows.Line: Several minutes later
Red Brick Center - Building 1, 1st Floor

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright everyone, see you next time. Remember to keep this a secret, okay?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line:
Okay! We promise!
Take care, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew, looks like they were satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But that took much longer than I expected. I don't want to keep Hoshino and the others waiting, so I'd better hurry.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We were all supposed to go around as a group, but we ended up separating. I feel bad.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: First things first, I need to go meet up with them as soon as I can.
2nd Floor
Apparel Store

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Where could they be?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They just replied to my message saying they were in this shop, but...)

Oh! There she is!
Hey!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tenma! Everyone! I'm so sorry for making you wait...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? What are you all doing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-da! We picked out some stuff that will create the perfect disguise for you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: We were just talking about what a famous person would wear and what would suit you, and ended up trying on a bunch of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A disguise that makes you look famous would defeat the purpose, though.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Oh, but don't worry! We didn't pick anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This way you'll be able to walk around without being interrupted!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right. Sorry for the trouble.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah! No, no, that's not what I meant!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I just want to enjoy today's trip as much as possible with you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, we got to be in the same group!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not just Saki. We all feel the same.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know that you really care about your fans, and perhaps it's selfish of us to feel this way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we really want to make the most of this field trip and have fun with you.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: We were thinking about what we can do to help, and the only thing we came up with was picking out some stuff for a disguise...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a special occasion, so please enjoy your field trip as any high school students would!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That's right... I came here to have fun as any regular student would.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I made plans with everyone for that purpose. And yet... I wasn't following through.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone. That makes me happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I do think a lot about my fans and want to give back what I can for their ongoing support.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But even so, I also really want to have fun with all of you. And that is the truth.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I think I'll take you up on your offer and let myself fully enjoy this trip!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's all have a great time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Going back to the disguise, what items have you picked out?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Well, we had a hard time picking out a hat, but what do you think of this flat cap?
I think this would totally suit you♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that's nice. It has a simple design and I can probably wear this on any regular day too.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Yeah, it looks really good on you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What about these sunglasses? I thought they would look really cool on you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I'll pass on those. They're a little too flashy and might actually attract more attention.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: See? I told you those were too flashy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I thought they'd look really good on her...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Glad that we were able to find something good!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Yeah! It really suits you, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I didn't realize that you could look so different just by wearing a hat. I don't think anyone will notice now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? That's a relief. Now I should be fine to relax and just enjoy walking around.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, what should we do next? Did you want to stay here for a little longer?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We managed to get the perfect disguise for you and I got my souvenirs, so I'm pretty satisfied!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. We finished up earlier than we planned, but shall we head out anyway?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Hey, did you see? Apparently Haruka Kiritani was here today.

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Huh? Haruka Kiritani? You mean THE Haruka Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Yup! She's trending on social media right now. Quite a few people are saying they saw her, so I think it's legit!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh no... They're talking about me.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did people find out from hearing those kids before?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I think so...
But it should be fine because of the hat you all picked out for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! They're coming this way!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Apparently, she's really pretty and slim in person! I wish I could see her!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line:
What if she's nearby?!
If we bump into her, let's try asking for a photo!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looks like they left...

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: I was so anxious that they were going to recognize you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too... My heart was racing.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: I know, right?! My palms are so sweaty!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehehe.
Operation Disguise was... A. Big. Success♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Yes, it was.
